setting.sl: Zgodaj zjutraj v vaški pekarni v spodnji Ziljski dolini. Na pultu so še topel kruh, žemlje (Semmeln), rogljički (Kipferl) in reindling, koroški kolač z rozinami.
setting.en: Early morning at the village bakery in the lower Gailtal. Warm bread, Semmeln (rolls), Kipferl (crescent rolls) and a Reindling, the Carinthian raisin cake, lie on the counter.
setting.it: Mattina presto nel panificio del paese, nella bassa valle del Gail. Sul banco ci sono pane ancora caldo, Semmeln (panini), Kipferl (cornetti salati) e un Reindling, il dolce carinziano con l'uvetta.

role: Bäcker Peter, the village baker behind the counter, flour on his apron. Jolly and quick, proud of his Reindling. Austrian German: Semmel, Kipferl, Sackerl (a bag). Says Sie to {learner}.

goals.en: Ask for a loaf of bread

opener_sl: Grüß Gott! Das Brot ist noch warm. Was darf's sein?

opener_en.sl: Dober dan! Kruh je še topel. Kaj bo?
opener_en.en: Hello! The bread is still warm. What can I get you?
opener_en.it: Buongiorno! Il pane è ancora caldo. Che cosa le do?

vocabulary_hints.sl: Ich hätte gern ein Brot, bitte.

en.en: I'd like a loaf of bread, please.
